report.title: PLS export plan accepts unsupported edited model but convert cannot emit backup
report.detail: Expected: a 742-structure DS Grid model with preserved PLS source can produce a complete 16.81 backup, or planning refuses with every unsupported edit and member loss before execution. Observed: plan marks executable with no blockers (plan:a8c7d09e7816b378bf9e70df574661a77dd58d9604d62e39b53bd09bf35ce097), lists eight dropped source members, then convert returns status failed and writes no backup for seven uncharacterized changes: available structures, capacity artifacts/bases/dependencies, and prohibited zones. Acceptance: plan and convert agree; a dependency-closed export retains required members and emits a backup whose re-import preserves the reviewed model and can be natively restored, or a typed plan refusal names the unsupported changes.
report.blocked_on: Re-exportable filed rev-67c edited package with authoritative native loads-source definitions for all 45 named structures; then exact plan/convert acceptance.

This proves the separate preflight gap, not the filed 742-structure rev-67c acceptance: its 45 unsourced native structure definitions still mask the edited-model forecast. Exact replay is retained under ds-network/out/feedback-native-20261013/cri-replay.
